mapper.select: select warn_id,rel_type, WM_CONCAT(rel_id) rel_ids GROUP_CONCAT(rel_id) rel_ids string_agg(rel_id,',') rel_ids from dete_warn_rel where warn_id=#{warnId} and del_flag='0' group by warn_id,rel_type

select * from dete_warn_rel dwr where (dwr.rel_type='1' and dwr.rel_id=#{typeId}) or (dwr.rel_type='2' and exists(select * from dete_set_info dsi where dsi.type_id=#{typeId} and dsi.state!='1' and dwr.rel_id=dsi.id)) and dwr.del_flag='0'
